This small plot is just a little piece near the house, only a tiny bit of land. I am an old woman now, 64 years, and I keep this plot mixed with a few crops together — what we eat at home. I cannot buy a whole bag of fertilizer for such a small piece, it would be wasting money I do not have. I put the manure from my few animals and the kitchen ash, and I save my own seeds from last season like my mother taught me. The rains here on the mountain are usually enough, so I do not carry water to this plot.
